title: Newly Established Sports Franchise Equity Stake For Sale in Noida, India
tagline: • Pre-revenue men's T10 tennis-ball cricket league preparing to launch its first season across 22 cities. • The league aims to create opportunities for cricket players, franchise partners, corporate sponsors, and cricket audiences through a structured grassroots cricket platform. • The business plans to offer six zonal franchise opportunities, player registrations and trials, sponsorship and branding opportunities, match ticketing, media and broadcast opportunities, and official merchandise. • The initial revenue model is based on player registration fees, with additional commercial opportunities planned through franchise partnerships, sponsorships, ticketing, media and broadcast rights, and merchandise. • The league is targeting approximately 1 lakh player registrations, with players participating through city-level registrations and trials. • The promoters bring over 14 years of experience across business development, operations, sales, and marketing, supported by prominent cricket and entertainment personalities associated with the league. • The business has a long-term roadmap to expand the league nationally and subsequently explore international markets. • As the league is pre-revenue and launching in approximately one month, commercial revenue has not yet commenced. • Operates with a valid GST certificate.
